subject: FORMATTED-CURRENT-DATE function
notes: One-argument printed form accepted and its result valid under its own combined format (FCD-VALID=00 per §15.92.4 r1); FUNCTION omitted → COBOL1543 (§8.4.3.2.3 SR2); a second argument → COBOL1504, the format printing none where §15.40.2/§15.41.2 print a bracketed one.
